text:
Maya (ML): FYI: onboarding run for marlin-v1 q4 produced locale regressions on our multilingual smoke set. Notably: high-token-id suppression (U+2026 ellipsis and a few CJK punctuation) and reversed paren ordering in RTL+latin mixes.
Rui: can you paste a failing example?
Maya (ML): minimal repro below. Observed on quant artifacts only (q4); fp16 baseline good.
```
input_ja:      
   
sample:    

Actual plain text example: 
"彼は言った…そして行った。"
expected detok: "彼は言った…そして行った。"
q4 detok: "彼は言った そして行った。"
```
Ilya: interesting. Does the tokenizer map ellipsis to a single high vocab id or a multi-subtoken sequence?
Maya (ML): single token id = 2051 in this model's vocab. High id range >2000 seems affected.
Sam: any change in quant table or dequant mapping recently?
Rui: yes, last deploy adjusted per-shard clamp params to reduce overflow for extreme logits. commit sha: 7f4c2b1. Might interact with per-id scale buckets.
Maya (ML): we ran a small sweep: revert clamp change -> q4 artifact preserves ellipsis. Re-apply clamp -> regression returns.
triage-bot: Filed ML-4218: "marlin-v1-q4: suppression of high-id locale tokens after clamp change" and attached canary metrics.
deploy-bot: Canary marlin-v1:q4 -> prod/us-east-1 started (canary=marlin-q4-210).
Sam: what's the canary impact?
Maya (ML): locale-smoke failure rate jumped to 4.1% (baseline 0.4%). BLEU ja->en down ~-2.6, chrF -1.8 on our small sample. RTL bracket flips cause user-visible punctuation errors.
Rui: hypothesis: clamp alters dequant offset for token id buckets > 2000; dequantized logits for those ids become artificially small -> suppressed.
Ilya: also check sampling op ordering. If top-k/top-p uses logits after clamping, high-id tokens might never make the cut.
Maya (ML): good call. I instrumented the sampling stage: for a failing step the raw dequant logits for id 2051 were -13.4, while neighboring ids ~ -0.3..1.2. On fp16 the same id logit ~0.9.
Rui: that's damning. Repro steps: 1) run `tools/locale_smoke.py --model marlin-v1 --quant q4 --emit-logs` 2) compare pre/post clamp dequant table `artifacts/marlin-v1/q4/dequant_table.npy` 3) collect logits and token ids.
Sam: add unit test: `tests/quant_edgecases/test_high_id_tokens.py` that asserts topN contains high-id example on a short prefix.
Maya (ML): I've uploaded sample dumps to ML-4218. Also added a temporary check in onboarding to fail promotion if any sample has ellipsis removed or RTL punctuation swapped.
triage-bot: ML-4218 updated: locale-smoke.log, dequant-table-before-after.npy, logits_snippets.txt attached.
Rui: working on a small patch to correct clamp index math. Will run full regression once CI finishes.
Ilya: if fix lands, let's add a canary salt test for multilingual punctuation (10 examples across ja/zh/ko/ar/he) to the canary healthcheck.
Sam: agreed. Also include a coverage test for vocab ids > 1800 since some models allocate high-range special tokens there.
Maya (ML): rolling back canary until patch lands. deploy-bot initiated rollback (canary marlin-q4-210 -> rolled back).
Rui: ETA for patch + CI: ~2.5 hours. Will ping when canary ready.
Maya (ML): thanks. Follow-up: update marlin onboarding doc with a "high-id token smoke" and add to pre-canary checklist.
Sam: noted — I'll add the checklist item in PR to `docs/onboarding/marlin.md`.
Maya (ML): closing loop for now. Will post final numbers after canary. :pray:
